breaker_01:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production card art for Vibespire. ONE square 1024x1024 image containing EXACTLY 4 columns and 4 rows, sixteen separate icons in row-major order. Equal square cells. Entire background pure flat magenta #FF00FF; clear 24px magenta gutters centred at x=256,512,768 and y=256,512,768, magenta outer margins. Each cell exactly one isolated centred illustration within central 70% width and 60% height. Phantasy Star 1987 Sega Master System pixel art; think actual 28x20 pixel drawing enlarged nearest neighbour. Thick black outline, large flat colour clusters, hard square pixels, maximum ten flat colours. Breaker armoured duellist: steel blue and deep purple with bronze or red accents and sparse pale cyan highlights. Large simple readable silhouettes, no tiny detail. NO text, labels, numbers, letters, faces, UI, frames, shadows, scenery, gradients, blur or antialiasing. Magenta only in background. Keep all sixteen illustrations visually distinct. Required row-major subjects:
Row 1 column 1: broad steel cleaver carving red crescent slash.
Row 1 column 2: blue tower shield with bronze central boss.
Row 1 column 3: spiked purple pauldron crashing through red sparks.
Row 1 column 4: crossed steel forearm braces beneath bronze shield.
Row 2 column 1: extended blue piston fist with red impact.
Row 2 column 2: steel chain flail swinging bronze spiked weight.
Row 2 column 3: vertical greatsword plunging through purple impact burst.
Row 2 column 4: bronze sledgehammer smashing split blue armour plate.
Row 3 column 1: double crescent poleaxe sweeping wide purple arc.
Row 3 column 2: steel pickaxe splitting red fissure through armour.
Row 3 column 3: three bronze rivet darts with blue streaks.
Row 3 column 4: suspended steel wrecking weight on bronze chain.
Row 4 column 1: wedge shaped blue battering ram with bronze spikes.
Row 4 column 2: hooked steel sabre reversing red crescent stroke.
Row 4 column 3: compact bronze knuckle gauntlet striking blue spark.
Row 4 column 4: blue clamp gauntlet gripping incoming steel sword.
